description:
NOC Device Health. Row 1: 7 tall device cards + Last update tile, each 3 cols wide and 8 rows tall for readable values. Each device card is a vertical stat panel with 4 reduced sub-metrics (PING / SNMP / MEM / CPU), colored by state. Row 2: Memory and CPU timeseries side-by-side, each 11 rows tall, legends renamed to device names via byFrameRefID displayName overrides. No expression-chained tiles — those were replaced by compact per-device cards which already answer 'who is unhealthy' at a glance. All itemids live-validated via /api/ds/query (28/28).

Unified scope (Site / Device type / Device / Metric): the section above the collapsed row follows the selectors; the collapsed row keeps the original fixed router wall unchanged.

panels.title: Devices in scope
panels.description: Devices selected by Site / Device type / Device (Zabbix inventory).

panels.title: UP
panels.description: ICMP ping answered in the last 10 minutes.

panels.title: DOWN
panels.description: ICMP ping failing in the last 10 minutes (or SNMP unavailable when there is no ICMP item).

panels.title: UNKNOWN
panels.description: Availability reported as unknown by Zabbix.

panels.title: NO DATA
panels.description: Monitored (data in the last 8 days) but no availability sample in the last 10 minutes: stale collection, NOT the same as DOWN.

panels.title: NOT MONITORED
panels.description: No availability data in the last 8 days: add or enable ICMP / SNMP availability monitoring in Zabbix.

panels.title: Device status
panels.description: One row per device in the selected scope. State comes from monitoring data (ICMP / SNMP availability), never from NetFlow traffic. "—" = no value in the last 10 minutes. A device that is reachable but has no CPU or Memory data stays UP.

panels.title: Availability timeline (ICMP)
panels.description: ICMP reachability of each selected device over the selected time range. One cell per 10 minutes (DOWN if any ping in it failed). An empty stretch means nothing was collected (a stale or missing collection, NOT the same as DOWN).

panels.title: Devices requiring attention
panels.description: Not UP, SNMP down, or CPU / Memory at or above 90 %. Not monitored and stale devices are listed too: they need an action in Zabbix.

panels.title: Metric explorer - ${metric}
panels.description: Choose one or several metrics with the Metric selector; every selected device is drawn so devices can be compared.

defaults.noValue: NO DATA for the selected devices and metric

panels.title: Original router wall (fixed set of routers, not filtered by the selectors)

panels.description: SNMP badge is derived from FRESH data, not the Zabbix availability flag (which stays "unknown" while SNMP works). OK: sysUpTime (SNMP, polled every 30 s) has a sample in the last 2 minutes. DOWN: no fresh SNMP sample while ICMP is still collected (or availability = 2). UNK: Zabbix has no data at all for this router. "—" on PING/MEM/CPU = no sample in the last 2 min. MEM is a calculated Zabbix item, so it is never used as proof of SNMP freshness.

Data behind the status table (do not edit)
Devices in the selected scope
panels.description: The device list is built from the selectors above (Zabbix inventory), so a device with no data at all still appears in the status table.

panels.title: Latest values (last 10m)
panels.description: PING 200=UP 100=DOWN, SNMP 2=OK 1=UNKNOWN 3=DOWN (encoded for the state logic). A device without a sample in the last 10 minutes has no row here.

panels.title: Availability data seen (last 8d)
panels.description: 1000 = at least one availability sample (ICMP or SNMP) exists in the last 8 days. Separates NO DATA (stale) from NOT MONITORED (never collected / disabled).

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.description: Site = Zabbix host group "Site/<name>". All = every monitored host, including hosts without a site group.

list.name: device_group
list.label: Device type
list.description: Device type = Zabbix host group "Type/<name>" (router, switch, ...).

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.description: Devices of the selected site and type. Pick one or several to compare. New Zabbix hosts appear here automatically.

list.name: metric
list.label: Metric
list.description: CPU, Memory and/or Availability for the metric explorer. Only metrics that are monitored on the selected devices return data.
list.query: CPU : CPU utilization, Memory : Memory utilization, Availability (ICMP) : ICMP ping
